The '''Bompreil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]], part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bompreil]].
